phrases.latin: In prīmō triviō, ut semper, dēlīberātum est. «Nōlō illāc īre, tata. Hāc eāmus!» «Fīat.»
phrases.english: At the first fork, as always, there was a debate. “I don’t want to go that way, Dad. Let’s go this way!” “All right.”

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
